1110.title: Tibetan Bowl Struck #1
1110.recording: Indoor; Tascam DR-40 and Sennheiser ME66
1110.selection: Ending: lower approximately 305 Hz mode, longest natural decay. Trim the pre-strike room noise and soften the upper resonances.

2553.title: Tibetan bowl struck #2
2553.recording: Studio; Sound Devices MixPre-3 and Sennheiser ME66
2553.selection: Starting: approximately 474 Hz lower mode; gentler measured strike than #3 and less upper-band prominence than #4.

2554.title: Tibetan bowl struck #3
2554.recording: Studio; Sound Devices MixPre-3 and Sennheiser ME66
2554.selection: Interval: similar approximately 473 Hz mode to the starting bowl, shorter decay. Soften its sharper strike and master below the other roles.

2555.title: Tibetan bowl struck #4
2555.recording: Studio; Sound Devices MixPre-3 and Sennheiser ME66
2555.selection: Retained comparison, not selected: strongest measured mode near 2.4 kHz, more early energy than #2. Selection is analytical, pending listening.
